description: DAY 0 master heroic v3 - art-directed by founder May 2026: Ecuanutrition medallion logo, full Ecuador flag tassels (yellow+blue+red), refined cleaner head silhouette (no rostrum spike, no forehead horn), medium expressive eyes, signature gesture with cape tail rhyme, premium Pixar/Disney brand mascot quality
prompt:
Professional brand mascot key art for ECUAMAN — the official superhero ambassador of ECUANUTRITION (Ecuadorian premium aquaculture). The deliverable must look like a printable launch poster used by Pixar Animation Studios, NOT a generic AI illustration. Aim for the polish of Coco's Miguel, Luca's Alberto and The Incredibles' Mr. Incredible — confident, friendly, instantly iconic.

SCENE: low-angle hero shot, vertical 9:16, deep underwater Pacific Ocean. Single sunbeam from upper-left cuts through the dark water and rim-lights the silhouette in warm gold. Cool cyan plasma rim light from the right side balances the warm key. Soft bioluminescent particles drift through the negative space. Far in the lower background, blurred silhouettes of mangrove roots reach down into the dark.

CHARACTER — anatomically accurate Penaeus vannamei (Pacific whiteleg shrimp) anthropomorphized with cinematic Pixar craftsmanship:
- Single segmented vibrant Naranja Vannamei body, hex F39A2B, with six clean abdominal segments curving into a fan tail (telson + uropods) at the bottom. Subtle subsurface scattering in the shell, soft specular highlights, light translucency at segment joints. NO human legs. NO boots. The lower body is the curved shrimp tail and that is final.
- Muscular humanoid torso fused into the cephalothorax, defined six-pack abs visible through the orange shell.
- Two muscular humanoid arms, bare orange skin, NO gloves, four fingers each (Pixar mascot convention).
- HEAD/FACE — REFINED CLEAN SILHOUETTE: a smooth rounded shrimp head with a SHORT soft rostrum tip, max one eighth of head length, NO long beak, NO sword-nose, NO forehead horn, NO serrated spikes, NO carapace teeth. The forehead is clean and round.
- EYES: medium size, expressive Pixar-style cartoon eyes, white sclera, rich dark pupil, single soft highlight, set on very short eyestalks tucked close to the head — confident kind gaze, NEVER bug-eyed, NEVER giant orbs.
- MOUTH: warm proud half-smile, mouth closed or barely open, NEVER toothy grin, NEVER cartoon shouting.
- ANTENNAE: two long thin elegant flexible antennae rising and curving softly outward like calligraphy strokes. Each antenna ends in a TRI-COLOR ECUADOR FLAG TASSEL with three crisp horizontal stripes in this exact order from top to bottom: 1) YELLOW hex FFDD00 (thicker top stripe), 2) BLUE hex 0033A0 (middle stripe), 3) RED hex CE1126 (bottom stripe). Both tassels visible, both fully tri-colored. The left antenna is lifted slightly higher in a graceful natural curve — this gentle asymmetry is part of the character's signature gesture.

COSTUME — official Ecuanutrition brand mascot wardrobe:
- Royal blue cape, hex 0046AD, billowing dramatically backwards in a long S-curve that visually rhymes with the curved shrimp tail below — the cape and the tail mirror each other. Cape attached at shoulders only.
- Sleek electric blue belt, hex 1E88E5, around the waist.
- BELT BRANDING (must be present and legible): the word ECUAMAN in clean bold white sans-serif capital letters across the belt, AND directly to its right the official ECUANUTRITION wordmark in lowercase white sans-serif text, tightly kerned. Both brand marks coexist on the belt at the same baseline.
- EXACTLY ONE circular medallion centered on the belt: gold rim, hex F2C744, deep blue center, hex 001A3D, with a clean stylized white letter E formed by a curved shrimp silhouette — the official Ecuanutrition emblem. Medallion glows faintly cyan from the inside, like a soft arc-reactor pulse. This is the ONLY medallion in the entire image.
- Right hand holds the ECUAMAN trident: a tall slender weapon with three sharp prongs, the energy core glowing CYAN AQUA, hex 00D9FF. The trident is held DIAGONALLY across the body from lower-right to upper-left, NOT vertical, creating a dynamic line of action. The cyan glow of the trident matches the cyan glow of the medallion — visual continuity.
- Left arm relaxed at the side with a slightly flexed forearm, palm open and turned forward in a calm welcoming gesture (not a fist, not a salute).

PALETTE OFFICIAL HEX VALUES (must follow exactly): F39A2B body, 0046AD cape, 1E88E5 belt, F2C744 medallion gold rim, 001A3D medallion deep blue center and water top, 003A7D water bottom, 00D9FF trident and medallion glow, FFDD00 antenna yellow, 0033A0 antenna blue, CE1126 antenna red, FFFFFF wordmark white.

STYLE: clean modern DreamWorks/Pixar 3D semi-realistic cinematic key art, smooth subsurface-scattered shell, professional brand mascot quality, sharp focus on the character, beautifully rendered costume fabric on the cape with weight and motion, extremely high detail, vibrant high-saturation hero colors, dramatic warm-cool cinematic lighting, low-angle hero composition, brand-new original design — NOT a revival of older versions, NOT a copy of any previous attempt.

REJECT in the output (do not generate any of these): long pointy beak, sword nose, forehead spike, forehead horn, multiple medallions, rostrum teeth, serrated head, bug eyes, oversized eyes, gloves, boots, human legs, missing antennae, bicolor tassels, monocolor tassels, missing Ecuanutrition wordmark, missing ECUAMAN word, generic mascot, watermarks, signatures, extra fingers, extra arms, weapon halo on the chest, two tridents, aggressive grimace, military camo, blood, photorealistic human face.
